description: The Breeze bridge contract. The page calls actions through window.breezeQuery (a JCEF message router); Java answers each one exactly once. Java pushes events through window.__breezeEvent. Both the TypeScript client (frontend/src/bridge) and the Java router (common/src/main/java/dev/breeze/bridge) are tested against this file.

app.hello.summary: Protocol version, mod and Minecraft versions, context (title or in-game), feature availability.

app.openExternal.summary: Open an allow-listed https link in the system browser. Never navigates the embedded browser.

ui.close.summary: Close the Breeze screen, if the current context allows closing.

ui.escapeAck.summary: The page answers a key.escape event. handled=false means it was already at the root.

ui.route.summary: The page reports its route so a reopened screen starts where the player left.

ui.vanillaMenu.summary: Show the vanilla title screen for the rest of this session.

game.state.summary: Player, world and connection facts read on the client thread.

game.joinServer.summary: Connect to a server the player has joined before.

game.pauseMenu.summary: Open Minecraft's own game menu while in a world.

game.quit.summary: Quit Minecraft. The page confirms first.

settings.get.summary: Breeze interface settings, stored locally on this computer.

settings.set.summary: Change one interface setting. Answers with the full settings.

settings.reset.summary: Restore every interface setting to its default.

modules.list.summary: Every Breeze module with its category, state and settings.

modules.setEnabled.summary: Turn a module on or off.

modules.reset.summary: Restore one module's settings to their defaults.

hud.openEditor.summary: Open the HUD editor, which moves the real HUD.

mods.list.summary: Mods Fabric actually loaded in this game.

account.get.summary: The Minecraft profile and the state of the Breeze sign-in the launcher handed over.

cosmetics.state.summary: Owned and equipped capes, and the 3D cosmetics the account wears, from the Breeze API.

cosmetics.equipCape.summary: Equip an owned cape, or unequip with no id.

friends.list.summary: Friends and requests, from the last poll of the Breeze API.

friends.request.summary: Send a friend request by Minecraft name.

friends.respond.summary: Accept or decline a friend request.

hosting.state.summary: Whether this world is being hosted, whether it could be, and invites from friends.

hosting.start.summary: Open the current singleplayer world to friends through the Breeze relay.

hosting.stop.summary: Stop hosting and close the relay session.

hosting.join.summary: Join a friend's hosted world from an invite.

events.key.escape: Escape was pressed in game. The page must answer with ui.escapeAck within 500 ms.
events.settings.changed: Interface settings changed. Payload: the full settings.
events.modules.changed: A module changed outside the page, for example by its keybind. Payload: { name }.
events.game.changed: The player joined or left a world. Payload: game.state.
events.window.resized: The game window changed size. Payload: { width, height, scale }.
